deviations.what: the Table's items model is the anonymous JSON model set in onInit (new JSONModel({modelData:[...]}), items='{path:/modelData}'); folded to the one default model as client->_bind( t_modeldata ) -> {/T_MODELDATA}. Same data, last path segment identical, structural-diff 0 diffs. Child bindings {product}/{type}/{additionalInfo} map to the upper-cased fields {PRODUCT}/{TYPE}/{ADDITIONALINFO}.

onPress (on the third, interactive ObjectMarker): the original does MessageToast.show( evt.getParameter( "type" ) + " marker pressed!" ); reproduced roundtrip-free as a client-composed toast (cs_event-control_global MESSAGE_TOAST, template '{0} marker pressed!' filled by ${$parameters>/type}). The press attribute is kept, so structural-diff sees no difference.
